description:
### *Mod variants have not yet been implemented into Runeforge v2.0. In the meantime if you wish to download other variants please use this mediafire link:* [*https://www.mediafire.com/folder/195oflecovlhn/Movement_Click_Arrows*](https://www.mediafire.com/folder/195oflecovlhn/Movement_Click_Arrows) *- By default these mods recolor all of the arrows to look the same. If you want the **move** and **attack move** to look different download another mod from the "Attack Move Only" folder and in CsLoL-Manager settings enable "Suppress install conflicts"*

#

### Information
